entries.0ec67d740b5ed8ba: This is the industry that makes vehicles such as automobiles and motorcycles and sells them around the world.
entries.1cb7aecd7fa4859b: There are transactions in which automakers and electric wire manufacturers purchase goods from trading companies.
entries.2a1d76a40ac81ff9: This category makes the materials that parts are made from, such as steel, aluminum, glass and chemical materials. In addition to the materials themselves, some companies shape them into forged or cast products and supply them to automakers and parts manufacturers.
entries.2e8ac978140f6210: There are transactions in which tire manufacturers purchase from chemical companies.
entries.3d957d99dcb0d671: This category delivers the vehicles that have been made to customers through dealers.
entries.44d3e7279b8ef0ae: This category gathers parts and materials to make finished vehicles such as passenger cars, commercial vehicles and motorcycles.
entries.56e60b2a2a7467dd: This category makes the materials that parts are made from, such as steel, aluminum, glass and chemical materials.
entries.645ec7cbece05e32: This category makes tires used on passenger cars, trucks and buses, and mining and construction vehicles.
entries.69b000df413a0b2e: Companies that make trucks and buses sell to businesses such as transport companies.
entries.6c77f487e620cc11: There are transactions in which tire manufacturers sell tires to retail companies.
entries.8456a625eabd5f4c: This category makes engine-related parts, brakes, steering, interiors such as seats, body frames, wiring and electronic components, and supplies them to automakers.
entries.97e19cc9ae376be9: This is the industry that makes vehicles such as automobiles and motorcycles and sells them around the world. Finished-vehicle manufacturers assemble and sell them, and around them, parts, tire and materials companies supply parts and materials. Finished-vehicle manufacturers also offer loans and leases to car buyers and dealers.
entries.ad6240105d5813db: There are transactions in which companies that make electric wires for automobiles also sell to construction companies.
entries.af34f7ed0741e6f8: Companies that make electric wires and metal materials for automobiles also sell to electrical equipment companies.
entries.b572693e8f19c655: Companies that make trucks and buses sell to businesses such as transport companies. There are also transactions in which parts companies sell to transportation companies.
entries.d0b26b25ed81ec4f: This category delivers the vehicles that have been made to customers through dealers. Manufacturer groups also handle the finance that supports sales, such as auto loans and leases for buyers and lending of funds to dealers.
entries.ee4dbe1843b51509: This category makes tires used on passenger cars, trucks and buses, and mining and construction vehicles. Tires fitted to new vehicles are sold to automakers, and replacement-market tires are sold to customers who are replacing their tires.
entries.ef80d92b3e911142: This category makes engine-related parts, brakes, steering, interiors such as seats, body frames, wiring and electronic components, and supplies them to automakers. Many companies stand out for selling mainly to the group of a particular large manufacturer.
entries.fea77a1ae2175f4d: This category gathers parts and materials to make finished vehicles such as passenger cars, commercial vehicles and motorcycles. It makes everything from kei cars to trucks and buses, as well as non-car vehicles such as outboard motors, and sells them around the world.
